name: Alternating Story Branches
note: An IntersectionObserver rooted on the scroller itself slides each entry in from its own side of a centre rail, with diamond nodes that pop as the entry lands.
html:
Seven years of Halden Press

  1. 2019

    Two desks in Aarhus

    A print shop, a borrowed guillotine, eleven titles.

  2. 2020

    The mail-order year

    Shops closed, so we posted 40,000 parcels ourselves.

  3. 2021

    First translation

    Bakken sold into six languages in one spring.

  4. 2023

    Bought the bindery

    Everything from proof to spine now happens on site.

  5. 2025

    Rewilding the paper

    Every run moved to 100% post-consumer stock.

  6. 2026

    Nineteen people

    Still eleven titles a year. On purpose.

name: Sticky Era Marker
note: An IntersectionObserver rooted on the scroller swaps a large year in the fixed left gutter, replaying a short slide keyframe each time the era changes.
html:
1836Built

A tower on the shingle

Stevenson's crew cut the base from granite barged out of Aberdeen. Eighty-two courses, no mortar above the waterline.

Paraffin and clockwork

The old Argand lamps gave way to a paraffin burner turning on a mercury bath. Two keepers, six hours on, six off.

Cable from the mainland

A four-mile submarine cable arrived in June. The light gained 340,000 candela and lost its clockwork weight shaft.

The January swell

A wave took the gallery railing and 14 panes of the lantern. The keepers logged it, relit at dusk, and stayed.

The last keeper leaves

Helmsman Croft closed the door on 12 November. Monitoring moved to a rack in Oban that fits under a desk.

Solar and sealed

An LED array on a 900W panel bank. Range 18 nautical miles, drawing less power than a kettle.

html:
Get Loom Studio ready1 of 5 done · about 6 min left

  1. Create your workspace

    Named it Northfield on the free tier.

  2. Invite two teammates

    Projects get useful the moment someone else can comment.

  3. Connect a repository

    Link GitHub or GitLab so builds attach to the right branch.

  4. Record a first clip

    Thirty seconds of screen is enough to see the pipeline run.

  5. Set a sharing default

    Workspace-only is safest; you can widen it per clip later.
